title: Establishing Meta-Decision Making for AI: An Ontology of Relevance, Representation and Reasoning
reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses "moral paradigms," "value-based moral decision-making systems" (MARS), "value alignment," and various ethical frameworks (virtue ethics, consequentialism, deontology) in the context of AI decision-making. It aims to establish an ontology for meta-decision making that incorporates these ethical considerations.
